While most of those who recommend it value the handling of the story's twists, most of those who do not recommend it, in the limited material analyzed, point to unlikable figures and harmful male attitudes.

textos.Muitas reviews destacam que o filme tece: Many reviews highlight that the film weaves criticism of rampant consumerism and of fragile or toxic masculinity, often pointing out that the work satirizes precisely those who idolize it without noticing its message.

textos.Lançado em 1999 e dirigido por David Fin: Released in 1999 and directed by David Fincher, Fight Club is a drama and thriller centered on a depressed man who suffers from insomnia and meets the soap salesman Tyler Durden. Together, they found an underground club with strict rules where men tired of their mundane lives fight one another, but the partnership between the two is shaken when Marla enters the dynamic.
textos.A experiência do filme se apoia em uma a: The film's experience rests on a dark atmosphere and a narrative structure that explores physical and psychological tensions, keeping a measured pace throughout its sequences.
textos.Os diferentes grupos avaliam os mesmos a: The different groups assess the same aspects of the work and agree on its central themes, disagreeing on the verdict about how the narrative works. In the vast majority of ratings (~90%), the twist is celebrated by about half, while a good portion praises the performances of Brad Pitt and Edward Norton, and a significant share values the criticism aimed at consumerism and toxic masculinity.
textos.Na leitura de quem se posiciona numa fra: In the view of those who fall within a minimal fraction of the ratings (~8%), several find the production overrated, while some point to reservations about pacing and engagement, and a smaller slice contests the treatment given to masculinity. Finally, from the perspective of an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~2%), many judge the film disappointing and overrated, a considerable number complain of a slow, dragging pace, and a good portion criticizes the presence of unpleasant characters and the approach to toxic masculinity.
